sanskrit:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥ १३-३१॥
iast:
yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvam ekasthamanupaśyati
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā 13-31
translation: When he (man) sees the whole variety-of-beings, as resting in the One, and spreading forth from That (One) alone, he then becomes BRAHMAN.
